verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a published llms.txt at docs.perplexity.ai and a machine-readable openapi.json. The Computer docs themselves are served as raw .md pages, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for this product. The .md.md 404 is only a malformed double-extension probe and does not count against this. Missing for 10: confirmation that the llms.txt index actually covers the Computer pages (the excerpt is truncated and API-focused), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
